objective: Native Rust siblings for the full @demlik/tea and @demlik/code-graph public capability set, with 1:1 observable behavior and a new idiomatic Rust API.
workflow: Local implementation and verification. No issue, PR, push, publication, merge or deployment is needed for this local goal.
acceptance: Preserve TypeScript behavior against the pinned source and dependency reference.
Rust calls native implementations, with no TypeScript forwarding or fixture-answer replay.
Every public export, nested callable, CLI entry, wildcard export and asset has an explicit Rust mapping and passing evidence.
Verify success, refusal and failure behavior, typed contracts, serialization, ordering, persistence, recovery, cancellation and realistic consumers.
Demonstrate detection of representative behavioral regressions on disposable source copies.
Pass relevant Rust and TypeScript checks and independent local review. Keep the goal incomplete while material gaps remain.
foundationAcceptance: Create the sibling Cargo workspace and a reusable cross-language runner with explicit failure accounting.
Port retry/backoff and iterative SCC with independent examples, generated cases and regression controls.
Port pure reducer/transition stepping, initialization, folds, replay, subscription identity and terminal refusal behavior.
Keep pure models free from blanket Clone, Send, serialization or runtime requirements.
Reject a full-parity claim until live public capability discovery has passing mappings.
status: Full port in progress; the foundation alone does not satisfy the objective.
